title: OPS-01 Dataset Construction & Leakage-Safe Train/Dev/Holdout Design Protocol
governance_invariants: Protocol definition does not authorize training.
Dataset construction does not automatically authorize training.
Training requires separate operator authorization after spot-check, leakage audit, and split manifest freeze.
Two slices belonging to the same parent SAR acquisition are never permitted to occupy different leakage partitions.
Part-III benchmark remains quarantined and untouched under Rule 38.
HM class must remain Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects; never renamed to Vessel.
Li OS class is strictly excluded from OPS-01 training.

source_identity_hierarchy.level_1_ultimate_source: ESA Copernicus Sentinel-1 Level-1 GRD/SLC SAFE Granule
source_identity_hierarchy.level_3_orbit_pass: orbit_pass_id for Wave Mode (e.g. S1A_009293_00D6BD: satellite, orbit, datatake, date)

grouping_policy.unknown_grouping_policy: Any sample with UNKNOWN grouping identity is strictly prohibited from entering the holdout benchmark.

scene_level_grouping_firewall.deterministic_algorithm_pseudocode:
1. Extract all unique parent grouping keys: G_IW = {scene_id}, G_WV = {orbit_pass_id}.
2. Sort all grouping keys lexicographically: G_sorted = sorted(G_IW U G_WV).
3. Generate deterministic hash for each group: H(g) = SHA256(salt + g).
4. Sort groups by hash H(g) to create deterministic pseudo-random ordering.
5. Compute slice counts per group: S(g).
6. Assign groups sequentially into partitions (TRAIN ~70%, DEV ~15%, HOLDOUT ~15%) using greedy bin-packing to balance slice counts while enforcing that every slice in group g is assigned to the exact same partition.
7. Assert intersection(TRAIN_groups, DEV_groups) == empty.
8. Assert intersection(TRAIN_groups, HOLDOUT_groups) == empty.
9. Assert intersection(DEV_groups, HOLDOUT_groups) == empty.

contract_a_pixel_space.description: Verification that label raster pixel (r, c) aligns geometrically with SAR intensity pixel (r, c) of the Li GeoTIFF.
contract_a_pixel_space.verification_method: Resolution and spatial dimension equality check (256x256), bounding box validation.

contract_b_geographic_space.description: Georeferenced placement of slice (r, c) to Earth coordinates (lat, lon).
contract_b_geographic_space.rule: Must not be represented as independently validated georegistration.

contract_c_parent_scene.description: Provenance trace of slice to exact parent Sentinel-1 SAFE acquisition.
contract_c_parent_scene.verification_method: Filename stem matching against authoritative parent manifest.

intensity_cross_correlation_spot_check_s.objective: Empirically test whether Li slice SAR backscatter matches native Level-1 backscatter at the inferred crop window.
intensity_cross_correlation_spot_check_s.target_sample: All available Level-1 SAFE granules with matching local GeoTIFF slices.
preprocessing: Extract native Level-1 window [min_line, max_line] x [min_pixel, max_pixel].
Apply calibrated radiometry (sigma-naught) and 10x block averaging to match Li 100m grid.
Standardize dynamic range (dB conversion and z-score normalization).
metrics: Normalized Cross-Correlation (NCC) peak location and value

decision_gates.ALIGNMENT_PASS: NCC peak at (0, 0) +/- 0.5 pixels, NCC >= 0.85, Pearson r >= 0.85
decision_gates.ALIGNMENT_CONDITIONAL: NCC peak within +/- 2.0 pixels, NCC >= 0.70, sub-pixel shift quantified
decision_gates.ALIGNMENT_FAIL: NCC peak displacement > 2.0 pixels or NCC < 0.70, indicating structural mismatch or orientation error

anchors.description: Featureless ambient ocean backscatter across varying sea states.
Biogenic surfactants, calm wind, internal wave troughs, frontal slicks.
Frontal steps, rain splash, convective cells, wind streaks.

negative_sampling_strategy.balancing_principle: Maintain balanced distribution between clean background, low-backscatter lookalikes, and discrete objects to prevent false-alarm bias.

metrics_to_measure: Pixel count and percentage per class
Dominant-parent concentration ratio (max slices from single scene / total slices)
class_balance_measurement_plan.policy: No blind loss reweighting before empirical baseline evaluation on unweighted dev split.

audit_checks: 1. Parent scene stem overlap between splits
2. Level-1 SAFE source product ID overlap between splits
4. Spatial bounding box overlap between slices across splits
5. Temporal acquisition timestamp proximity (< 1 hour) across splits
6. Orbit pass ID overlap for Wave Mode across splits
9. Geographic cluster distance separation (> 50 km between train and holdout where feasible)
leakage_audit_spec.gate_rule: Any detected leakage violation immediately fails dataset validation.

holdout_governance.holdout_role: Untouched final capability benchmark for OPS-01.
strict_firewall_rules: No decision threshold calibration against holdout.
No class reweighting adjustments against holdout.
No architectural model selection against holdout.
Distinct and completely independent from protected Part-III benchmark.
